title: answer.refused@1
description: An answer reached an ask that had already closed, and the core refused it: it names how the ask closed, when, and the channel the answer came from. It changes nothing about the ask, and nothing reaches the agent. Only the core appends it.

subject.description: The ask this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

via.description: The channel the refused answer came from.
